title: DRAFT Registry companion 1.0.0: harness report
description: Staged and proposed with spec/registry.md, which governs where they differ; not released, and served by no bundle and no site. A harness report (section 11.5).
$comment: Section 11.5 says the report names the level and has one row per vector and check, pass, fail, skip with its reason, or info, but names none of their members; the schema therefore holds the selector alone and is not closed.
